monitor.sql: update "monitor_incidents" set "resolved_at" = ? where (("monitor_incidents"."target_id" = ? and "monitor_incidents"."resolved_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "monitor_targets" where ("monitor_targets"."id" = ? and "monitor_targets"."revision" = ?)))

update "monitor_notifications" set "status" = ? where ("monitor_notifications"."status" in (?, ?) and "monitor_notifications"."kind" = ? and "monitor_notifications"."incident_id" in (select "id" from "monitor_incidents" where ("monitor_incidents"."target_id" = ? and "monitor_incidents"."resolved_at" is not null)) and exists (select "id" from "monitor_targets" where ("monitor_targets"."id" = ? and "monitor_targets"."revision" = ?)))

insert into "monitor_notifications" ("id", "incident_id", "endpoint", "kind", "slot", "body", "status", "attempts", "next_attempt_at", "lease_token", "lease_expires_at", "accepted_at", "created_at") select lower(hex(randomblob(16))) as "id", "monitor_incidents"."id", "push_subscriptions"."endpoint", ? as "kind", 0 as "slot", ? as "body", 'pending' as "status", 0 as "attempts", ? as "nextAttemptAt", null as "leaseToken", null as "leaseExpiresAt", null as "acceptedAt", ? as "createdAt" from "monitor_incidents" inner join "push_subscriptions" on 1 where ("monitor_incidents"."target_id" = ? and "monitor_incidents"."resolved_at" is not null and not exists (select "id" from "monitor_notifications" "reserved_recovery" where ("reserved_recovery"."incident_id" = "monitor_incidents"."id" and "reserved_recovery"."kind" = ? and "reserved_recovery"."slot" = ? and "reserved_recovery"."endpoint" = "push_subscriptions"."endpoint")) and exists (select "id" from "monitor_notifications" "accepted_alert" where ("accepted_alert"."incident_id" = "monitor_incidents"."id" and "accepted_alert"."endpoint" = "push_subscriptions"."endpoint" and "accepted_alert"."accepted_at" is not null and "accepted_alert"."kind" = ?))) on conflict do nothing

calendar.sql: update "calendar_reminders" set "status" = ? where ("calendar_reminders"."status" in (?, ?) and "calendar_reminders"."event_id" not in (select "calendar_events"."id" from "calendar_events" inner join "collection_settings" on "collection_settings"."id" = ? where ("calendar_events"."id" = "calendar_reminders"."event_id" and ("calendar_events"."status" = ? and "collection_settings"."notifications_enabled" = ? and "calendar_events"."calendar_key" = 'tokushima-2026-' || "collection_settings"."district" and "calendar_events"."id" not in (select "calendar_preparations"."event_id" from "calendar_preparations" inner join "tasks" on "tasks"."id" = "calendar_preparations"."task_id" where "tasks"."status" in (?, ?)) and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') > ?) and (("calendar_reminders"."slot" = ? and "calendar_reminders"."due_at" = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."previous_day_time" || ':00+09:00', '-1 day')) or ("calendar_reminders"."slot" = ? and "calendar_reminders"."due_at" = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."same_day_time" || ':00+09:00'))))))

update "calendar_deliveries" set "status" = ?, "lease_token" = ?, "lease_expires_at" = ? where ("calendar_deliveries"."status" in (?, ?) and ("calendar_deliveries"."reminder_id" in (select "id" from "calendar_reminders" where "calendar_reminders"."status" in (?, ?)) or "calendar_deliveries"."endpoint" not in (select "endpoint" from "push_subscriptions")))

insert into "calendar_reminders" ("id", "event_id", "slot", "due_at", "expires_at", "status") select "calendar_events"."id" || ':' || ? || ':' || strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."previous_day_time" || ':00+09:00', '-1 day') as "id", "calendar_events"."id", ? as "slot", strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."previous_day_time" || ':00+09:00', '-1 day') as "dueAt", strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') as "expiresAt", 'scheduled' as "status" from "calendar_events" inner join "collection_settings" on "collection_settings"."id" = ? where (("calendar_events"."status" = ? and "collection_settings"."notifications_enabled" = ? and "calendar_events"."calendar_key" = 'tokushima-2026-' || "collection_settings"."district" and "calendar_events"."id" not in (select "calendar_preparations"."event_id" from "calendar_preparations" inner join "tasks" on "tasks"."id" = "calendar_preparations"."task_id" where "tasks"."status" in (?, ?)) and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') > ?) and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."previous_day_time" || ':00+09:00', '-1 day') > ? and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."previous_day_time" || ':00+09:00', '-1 day')) on conflict ("calendar_reminders"."event_id", "calendar_reminders"."slot", "calendar_reminders"."due_at") do update set "status" = ? where "calendar_reminders"."status" = ?

insert into "calendar_reminders" ("id", "event_id", "slot", "due_at", "expires_at", "status") select "calendar_events"."id" || ':' || ? || ':' || strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."same_day_time" || ':00+09:00') as "id", "calendar_events"."id", ? as "slot", strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."same_day_time" || ':00+09:00') as "dueAt", strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') as "expiresAt", 'scheduled' as "status" from "calendar_events" inner join "collection_settings" on "collection_settings"."id" = ? where (("calendar_events"."status" = ? and "collection_settings"."notifications_enabled" = ? and "calendar_events"."calendar_key" = 'tokushima-2026-' || "collection_settings"."district" and "calendar_events"."id" not in (select "calendar_preparations"."event_id" from "calendar_preparations" inner join "tasks" on "tasks"."id" = "calendar_preparations"."task_id" where "tasks"."status" in (?, ?)) and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') > ?) and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."same_day_time" || ':00+09:00') > ? and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T08:30:00+09:00') > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', "calendar_events"."date" || 'T' || "collection_settings"."same_day_time" || ':00+09:00')) on conflict ("calendar_reminders"."event_id", "calendar_reminders"."slot", "calendar_reminders"."due_at") do update set "status" = ? where "calendar_reminders"."status" = ?
